我們重複使用塑膠袋以減少垃圾。
The reuse of old paper saves trees.
舊紙的再利用可以節省樹木。
This bottle is designed for easy reuse.
這個瓶子的設計方便重複使用。
Thick smog covered the city this morning.
今天早上濃濃的霧霾籠罩了這座城市。
Smog makes it hard to breathe for some people.
霧霾讓有些人呼吸困難。
The city held a participatory meeting so residents could share ideas.
市政府舉辦了參與式會議，讓居民表達想法。
This class uses a participatory style of learning.
這門課採用參與式的學習方式。
The teacher tried to quell the noise in the classroom.
老師試圖讓教室裡的吵鬧聲平息下來。
Police acted quickly to quell the riot.
警方迅速行動以平息暴動。
He took a deep breath to quell his fear.
他深吸一口氣來壓下心中的恐懼。
His rude comment enraged the whole audience.
他無禮的言論激怒了全體觀眾。
Nothing enrages her more than being ignored.
沒有什麼比被忽視更讓她氣憤。
Damascus is the capital of Syria.
大馬士革是敘利亞的首都。
Damascus is often described as one of the oldest cities in the world.
大馬士革常被形容為世界上最古老的城市之一。
He raised his stein and said cheers.
他舉起啤酒杯說乾杯。
The shop sells beer steins decorated with painted scenes.
這間店賣繪有風景圖案的啤酒杯。

herein.zh: 在此、於此（用於正式文件）
ai: The terms described herein apply to all members.
此處所述的條款適用於所有會員。
All information contained herein is correct as of today.
本文所載的所有資訊至今日止皆正確。
Regular pruning helps the roses grow better.
定期修剪能讓玫瑰長得更好。
My grandfather spends every spring on the pruning of his apple trees.
我爺爺每年春天都花時間修剪他的蘋果樹。
Each granule of sugar dissolved quickly in the hot tea.
每一顆糖粒在熱茶裡很快就溶化了。
The medicine comes as small granules you mix with water.
這種藥是小顆粒狀的，要用水沖服。
The gang gained notoriety for its crimes.
這個幫派因為犯罪而惡名昭彰。
He gained notoriety after the scandal.
那次醜聞之後，他變得惡名遠播。
A herd of reindeer crossed the snowy field.
一群馴鹿穿過雪地。
Santa's sleigh is pulled by reindeer in the story.
故事裡聖誕老人的雪橇是由馴鹿拉的。

bulgarian.zh: 保加利亞人；保加利亞語
ai: My classmate is a Bulgarian who speaks four languages.
我的同學是個會說四種語言的保加利亞人。
She is learning Bulgarian before moving to Sofia.
她在搬去索菲亞之前正在學保加利亞語。

sultan.zh: 蘇丹（某些伊斯蘭國家君主的稱號）
ai: The sultan ruled the empire from his grand palace.
蘇丹在宏偉的宮殿裡統治著帝國。
Stories about a generous sultan are told in many old tales.
許多古老故事都在講一位慷慨的蘇丹。
The detective investigated the city's criminal underworld.
偵探調查這座城市的黑社會。
In Greek myths, Hades rules the underworld.
在希臘神話中，黑帝斯統治著冥界。
She has played the cello since she was eight.
她從八歲起就開始拉大提琴。
The deep sound of the cello filled the room.
大提琴低沉的聲音充滿整個房間。
He practices karate twice a week at the gym.
他每週在體育館練兩次空手道。
Karate began in Okinawa, Japan.
空手道起源於日本沖繩。

tableau.zh: 生動的場面、靜態造型畫面
ai: The family around the fireplace made a warm tableau.
圍在壁爐旁的一家人構成了溫馨的畫面。
The students formed a tableau of a famous painting.
學生們擺出一幅名畫的靜態造型。
The officer rested his hand on his holster.
警官把手放在槍套上。
She wore a leather holster on her belt.
她的腰帶上掛著一個皮槍套。
He became agitated when the plane started to shake.
飛機開始搖晃時，他變得焦躁不安。
The agitated crowd waited outside the closed doors.
激動的群眾在緊閉的大門外等待。
The two brothers bicker about everything.
那兩兄弟什麼事都要吵。
Stop bickering and help me carry these boxes.
別吵了，過來幫我搬這些箱子。
Photos of the family stood on the mantelpiece.
全家人的照片擺在壁爐台上。
She put the clock on the mantelpiece above the fire.
她把時鐘放在壁爐上方的壁爐台上。
Please go to your assigned seat.
請到你被指定的座位。
Each student finished the assigned reading before class.
每位學生都在上課前讀完了指定的閱讀材料。
The centrality of family in their culture is clear.
家庭在他們文化中的核心地位十分明顯。
Scholars discussed the centrality of trade to the city's growth.
學者討論了貿易對這座城市發展的核心重要性。
Many parents struggle to afford childcare.
許多父母難以負擔托兒費用。
The company offers free childcare for its employees.
這家公司為員工提供免費的托兒服務。

amish.zh: 阿米許人（美國保守的基督教派）
ai: The Amish live simply and avoid modern technology.
阿米許人過著簡樸的生活，不使用現代科技。
We bought fresh bread from an Amish farm in Pennsylvania.
我們在賓夕法尼亞州的一座阿米許農場買了新鮮麵包。
He tends to understate his own talent when people praise him.
別人稱讚他時，他總是把自己的才能說得很保守。
Don't understate the risks just to make the plan sound good.
別為了讓計畫聽起來不錯就把風險說得太輕。
This shirt is made of polyester and dries quickly.
這件襯衫是聚酯纖維做的，乾得很快。
Polyester is cheaper than silk but less breathable.
聚酯纖維比絲便宜，但透氣性較差。
The submarine carried several torpedoes on board.
這艘潛艇上載有數枚魚雷。
A torpedo is a kind of underwater weapon used by navies.
魚雷是海軍使用的一種水下武器。
One careless comment could torpedo the whole deal.
一句不經意的話就可能把整筆交易搞砸。
The sudden budget cut torpedoed their project.
突然的預算刪減讓他們的專案泡湯了。
The clinic gives free advice about contraceptives.
診所提供有關避孕用品的免費諮詢。
She uses a contraceptive recommended by her doctor.
她使用醫生推薦的避孕方式。
The doctor explained several contraceptive methods.
醫生說明了幾種避孕方法。
Contraceptive pills must be taken as directed.
避孕藥必須依指示服用。

postcolonial.zh: 後殖民的、殖民時期之後的
ai: She teaches a class on postcolonial literature.
她教一門後殖民文學的課。
Many postcolonial countries are still building their institutions.
許多後殖民時代的國家仍在建立自己的制度。
The lion shook its thick golden mane.
獅子甩動著牠濃密的金色鬃毛。
She brushed the horse's mane until it shone.
她把馬的鬃毛刷到發亮。

pulitzer.zh: 普立茲（美國報業人物，普立茲獎以其命名）
ai: Joseph Pulitzer was a newspaper publisher in the United States.
約瑟夫·普立茲是美國的報業發行人。
The Pulitzer Prize is named after him.
普立茲獎就是以他命名的。
He dutifully called his mother every Sunday.
他每個星期天都盡責地打電話給媽媽。
The children dutifully lined up at the door.
孩子們乖乖地在門口排好隊。

gogh.zh: 梵谷（荷蘭畫家 Van Gogh 的姓）
ai: Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch painter.
文森·梵谷是荷蘭畫家。
The museum has a large collection of van Gogh's paintings.
這間博物館收藏了大量梵谷的畫作。
The speech was a strong stand against bigotry.
這場演講堅定地反對偏見。
Bigotry can make people treat others unfairly.
偏見會讓人不公平地對待他人。
The digging took the workers all afternoon.
這項挖掘工作花了工人整個下午。
After a lot of digging, they found an old coin.
挖了好久之後，他們找到一枚舊硬幣。
The cliff is made of layers of soft shale.
這片懸崖是由一層層柔軟的頁岩組成。
Oil and gas can be found in shale rock.
頁岩層中可以找到石油與天然氣。
I'm tired of her nagging voice reminding me about chores.
我受夠了她那嘮嘮叨叨提醒我做家事的聲音。
A nagging parent can make a teenager want to rebel.
愛嘮叨的父母可能讓青少年想反抗。

nagging.zh: 揮之不去的、持續困擾的
ai: I have a nagging pain in my back.
我背部一直有種揮之不去的痛。
A nagging doubt kept him awake all night.
一個揮之不去的疑慮讓他整晚睡不著。
He wore a cast on his fractured arm.
他骨折的手臂上打著石膏。
The fractured pipe caused water to leak into the basement.
破裂的水管讓水漏進了地下室。

fractured.zh: 使骨折、使斷裂（fracture 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: She fractured her wrist when she fell off the bike.
她從腳踏車上摔下來時手腕骨折了。
The rock fractured into several pieces.
那塊石頭裂成了好幾塊。
The mechanic said the gearbox needs to be replaced.
技師說變速箱需要更換。
There is a strange noise coming from the gearbox.
變速箱傳來一種奇怪的聲音。

auspice.zh: 吉兆；贊助、主辦（常用 auspices）
ai: The festival was held under the auspices of the local government.
這個慶典是在地方政府的贊助下舉辦的。
The research took place under the auspices of the university.
這項研究是在大學的主持下進行的。

crete.zh: 克里特島（希臘最大的島）
ai: Crete is the largest island in Greece.
克里特島是希臘最大的島嶼。
Many tourists visit the beaches of Crete every summer.
每年夏天都有許多遊客造訪克里特島的海灘。

speechless.zh: 說不出話的、啞口無言的
ai: The beautiful view left us speechless.
那片美景讓我們說不出話來。
She was speechless with anger after hearing the news.
聽到消息後，她氣得說不出話。
The kitten is small, soft, and furry.
這隻小貓又小又軟，毛茸茸的。
He wore a furry hat in the cold weather.
天氣冷時他戴著一頂毛茸茸的帽子。

equalise.zh: 使平等、使相等；（比賽中）追平比分
ai: The new rule aims to equalise opportunities for all students.
這項新規定的目的是讓所有學生的機會均等。
Our team equalised in the last minute of the game.
我們隊在比賽的最後一分鐘追平了比分。

predispose.zh: 使易於（某種傾向）、使預先傾向
ai: Some genes may predispose people to heart disease.
有些基因可能使人較容易罹患心臟病。
A bad first impression can predispose you against someone.
不好的第一印象可能讓你對某人先有成見。
The workers resented their subordination to the new manager.
工人們對於要從屬於新經理感到不滿。
The subordination of personal wishes to the team's goals is sometimes necessary.
有時必須讓個人意願服從團隊的目標。
The two warring countries finally agreed to a ceasefire.
那兩個交戰的國家終於同意停火。
Aid workers helped families trapped between the warring groups.
救援人員幫助被困在敵對雙方之間的家庭。
I had a slice of kiwi with my yogurt.
我的優格裡加了一片奇異果。
A kiwi is green inside and has small black seeds.
奇異果裡面是綠色的，有小小的黑籽。
The kiwi is a bird that cannot fly.
奇異鳥是一種不會飛的鳥。
We saw a kiwi at a nighttime bird house in New Zealand.
我們在紐西蘭的夜間鳥館看到了一隻奇異鳥。
My roommate is a Kiwi from Auckland.
我的室友是來自奧克蘭的紐西蘭人。
The Kiwis cheered loudly for their rugby team.
紐西蘭人為他們的橄欖球隊大聲加油。
Security at the building was lax, so anyone could walk in.
那棟大樓的保全很鬆散，任何人都能走進去。
The teacher was lax about deadlines.
那位老師對繳交期限很寬鬆。
